Summary: [Top Website Menu] Check that the top menu bar, logo, and links work properly in Google Chrome
Description:
Test Case ID: TC-001
Feature: Top Website Menu
Category: Website Pages
Summary: Check that the top menu bar, logo, and links work properly in Google Chrome
Precondition: Open Google Chrome and go to the website homepage.
Test Steps:
Step 1: Open the website in Google Chrome.
Step 2: Look at the top menu bar and check that the logo and name are visible.
Step 3: Click each menu tab: "PDF", "Image", "Word", "Excel", "Media".
Step 4: Check that the page smoothly switches to show tools for that category.
Expected Result: The menu stays at the top, links work instantly, and colored lines show which category you are on.

Test Case ID: TC-002

Category: Website Pages

Precondition: Website is open in Google Chrome.
Test Steps:

Step 2: Check that the background switches from white to dark (or dark to white).
Step 3: Refresh the web page in Chrome (press F5 or Ctrl+R).
Step 4: Check that your dark or light mode choice is still saved.
Expected Result: The screen colors change smoothly and Google Chrome remembers your choice even after refreshing.
